title: Zelenskyy Sees No Quick End to War in Ukraine
description:
Ukraine is looking for a "package" from allies that would cover air defense reinforcements as well as energy, including US LNG. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy spoke to reporters after talks in Kyiv with Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, later joined by national security chiefs from the UK, France and Germany. Bloomberg's Greg Sullivan reports.
